title: CarsSearch brand checklist
description: Schema for Config/brands.json — the immutable reference checklist of car brands grouped by parent company. The search pipeline reads this file to derive each request's per-brand checklist and never writes to it; progress state belongs to request.json.

group_id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. 'g03-vw'. The numeric part preserves the owner's original list ordering.

active.description: False excludes every brand in the group from active searches (e.g. the distressed/defunct group). Request completion is evaluated over active groups only.

note.description: Why the group is grouped or flagged the way it is.

brand_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique across the whole file (not just within its group).

name.description: Brand display name as the owner listed it.

aliases.description: Alternative spellings/trade names used when matching this brand in search results and page text. May be empty.

note.description: Market/status context, e.g. bankruptcy date or home market.
